tool.name: operator_run_dynamic_revit_program

mode.description: read: nonmutating snapshot report or explicit native_program read; preview: snapshot/graph rollback only; apply: authorized edit with independent verification. Native compilation alone and native commit alone are not task verification.

snapshot_limit.description: Maximum native snapshot rows: read up to4096; preview/apply up to1000. Inspect c.Input.Coverage.HasMore before claiming complete enumeration.

effect_scope.description: For general native-code writes use active_document: the admitted current document, actual change audit and requested-result verification; no predicted collateral IDs. Omit legacy target/create/count restrictions in this mode. Existing listed_elements callers retain strict declared targets.

native_program.description: Development/laboratory Revit2024 native C#: public static string Execute(Autodesk.Revit.DB.Document). mode read or apply only. Reads need no effect targets. General writes may explicitly use effect_scope active_document without predicting dependent changes; listed_elements retains legacy restrictions. No transaction, SaveAs, filesystem or network in source. Host manages the transaction; returned text is not verification. Review source against the task and verify the requested persisted result. Do not combine with snapshot, graph, resume or checkpoint options.

resume.description: Bind this attempt to exact retained evidence from the prior run. facts preserves source and expands requested observations; repair changes retryable source; retry preserves source for a retryable transient failure.

continue_from_checkpoint.description: Start a new diagnostic loop from one exact committed_verified checkpoint. The same Revit document/session must still be active; restart reconciliation is explicit and never inferred.

invocation.name: operator_run_dynamic_revit_program
invocation.arguments: Use the exact inputSchema; execution remains subject to current admission and source/effect limits.
